s.en: In an emergency, call this number.
There was an emergency in our building last night.
s.ko: 어젯밤에 우리 건물에 응급 상황이 있었어요.

s.en: The doctor will come in an emergency.
The fire alarm makes a very loud sound.
s.ko: 화재 경보는 아주 큰 소리를 내요.

s.en: A small fire started in the kitchen yesterday.
We will learn what to do in a fire.
s.ko: 우리는 화재 시 할 일을 배울 거예요.

s.en: The police station is across the road.
The police helped my neighbor last night.
I will call the police if I see danger.
s.ko: 위험을 보면 저는 경찰을 부를 거예요.

s.en: Snow on the road is a danger for old people.
We were in danger during the storm last summer.
s.ko: 우리는 지난여름 폭풍 때 위험에 처했어요.

s.en: The sign will show people the danger.
s.ko: 표지판이 사람들에게 위험을 보여 줄 거예요.

s.en: I take a first aid class at the center.
s.ko: 저는 센터에서 응급 처치 수업을 들어요.

s.en: The nurse gave first aid to the child this morning.
s.ko: 오늘 아침에 간호사가 그 아이에게 응급 처치를 했어요.

s.en: Our class will learn first aid next month.
s.ko: 우리 반은 다음 달에 응급 처치를 배울 거예요.

s.en: A hat protects your head from the sun.
My husband protected me from the wind yesterday.
s.ko: 제 남편은 어제 바람으로부터 저를 지켜 줬어요.

s.en: The wall will protect the house from water.
s.ko: 그 벽이 물로부터 집을 보호할 거예요.

s.en: We know how to escape from the building.
Everyone escaped from the fire last night.
We will escape through the back door.
A loud shout means a person needs help.
s.ko: 큰 외침은 어떤 사람이 도움이 필요하다는 뜻이에요.

s.en: I heard a shout from the street this morning.
s.ko: 저는 오늘 아침에 거리에서 외치는 소리를 들었어요.

s.en: A shout will bring the neighbors quickly.
The doctor answers the phone quickly.
The police came quickly last night.
We will leave the building quickly.
The radio gives a warning about the storm.
We got a warning about the rain yesterday.
The city will send a warning by phone.
